verdict.rationale: There is no documented 'export all data' or account-exit feature. The evidence shows only piecemeal paths out: agent-generated artifacts (reports, spreadsheets, code files) can be downloaded, organization skills can be kept in sync with a GitHub repository, and the Python SDK/API can programmatically access agents, sessions, skills and artifacts. Missing for 10: a bulk or complete data export, documentation of open export formats for agents/triggers/conversation history, a documented offboarding/account-deletion path, and independent corroboration.
